A.purpose: task-scale finite-noise candidate exploration, not assumed topology modes or posterior sampling
A.direction_source: A_ONLINE_GEOMETRY.npz frozen before offline GT evaluation
A.common_constraints: original legal decoder; inward loss-bound half-ray; |actual RMS - .02| <= .0004, task floor .02 with 1e-10 numerical tolerance; signed material progress >= .01; Gaussian latent displacement <= 1; original property bounds

proposal_objectives.Full-J: minimize frozen-anchor quadratic latent posterior objective subject to common exact-decoder constraints
proposal_objectives.native: minimize material goal error plus 1e-8 latent tie-breaker subject to the same constraints

A.common_corrector: one bounded Full-J local quadratic correction after the first measured proposal; same exact-decoder distance/progress constraints; no return-to-anchor counted

each_arm_direction_cap.breakdown: proposal F 8 + shared receiver J 32 + corrected F 8

A.data_feasible: original white residual <= 23.785449004057032; backward residual <=1e-10; prior legal
A.likelihood_competitive: DeltaPhi <=2 relative to the fixed A anchor; declared heuristic, not credible region
A.prior_reporting: exact frozen latent logprior and change; no material-volume-density conversion or residual softmax
A.deduplication: fixed arm/direction order; pairwise material RMS >=.02 for distinct task-scale candidates, numerical tolerance 1e-10
A.structure_reporting: original P1 fraction change >=.15 in >=4 connected cells plus smoothed fraction RMS>=.01; topology separately; none of the currently generated rays pass this structure test
A.endpoint_selection: lowest actual Phi among measured legal radius/progress-matched endpoints; never GT
A.secondary_RMS_0p04: decoder-only negative/stress result retained; no paid .04 extension in this minimal proposal

B.purpose: restore independent physics-only anchor from its saved nonconverged endpoint
B.start: P1_obs_B saved state_0048 and paid last Jacobian, not N3/GT reinitialization
arms: continue original bounded LM + fixed post-solve .5 Gaussian cap
direct bounded adaptive trust-region quadratic subproblem
B.target_objective: Phi + .5 norm(z64)^2, frozen latent prior and likelihood

adaptive_TR.acceptance: actual posterior-objective decrease with positive predicted reduction
adaptive_TR.expand: rho>.75 and step at >=.9 radius: radius x2 up to2
adaptive_TR.shrink: rho<.25 or rejection: radius /2 down to .03125
adaptive_TR.subproblem: optimize quadratic under radius and original property bounds directly; do not uniformly shrink an unconstrained solution

per_arm_cap.breakdown: 8 forward x8 + at most8 refreshed receiver Jacobians x32, including terminal KKT diagnostics

B.qualification: unchanged prior legality, white residual<=23.785449004057032, backward residual<=1e-10; stationarity reported separately, not required for a feasible base

A17_X.meaning: fixed legal material, finite-state/current enrichment; separate from decoder retraction and Full-J optimization
required_controls: ordinary goal-oriented ROM with same reuse rights
A17_X.same_space_control: ordinary Galerkin and A17 must agree at the same V,C; no intrinsic accuracy gain claim
A17_X.exact_port_cost: common prior ROI support up to256 cells per anchor; latent66 is not port66; propagate columns charged separately

stop_rules: No automatic authorization from this file
No added iterations or lower material scale to rescue results
No NN or mode/probability claims without reference
